title: Hello, XIOM!
concept: Use io.println to display text on the screen.
why: Programs need to communicate with the user. Printing text is the most basic form of output.
tips: Strings always use double quotes, like `"hello"`
Each `io.println` call prints on its own line
Return 0 from main to signal success
The text inside quotes is called a 'string literal'
common_mistakes: Using single quotes instead of double quotes
